variants.simple: Create kanban-style task board for project management.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive kanban-style task board for project management. Board structure: horizontal scrollable columns, each column is a status (Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Review, Done), column header with title and task count. Column features: add new column, rename column, delete empty column, set WIP limit, collapse/expand column. Task cards: title (1-2 lines), labels (colored tags), assignee avatar(s), due date, comment count, priority indicator. Card actions: click for detail modal, drag and drop to move, quick edit on hover. Drag and drop: smooth dnd with visual feedback, drop zones highlight, reorder within column, move between columns. Quick add: input field at bottom of column, press Enter to add, or dedicated Add button. Task detail modal: full description (markdown support), comments thread, attachments, activity log, subtasks, custom fields. Filters: assignee filter, label filter, due date filter, search by title, my tasks toggle. Swimlanes: optional horizontal grouping by assignee, priority, or custom field, collapsible swimlanes. WIP limits: configure max cards per column, visual warning when limit exceeded (red border), encourage finishing over starting. Sorting: within column sort by due date, priority, or manual order. Labels: create and manage labels, multi-select on cards. Bulk actions: select multiple cards, bulk move or edit. Views: toggle between board and list view. Keyboard shortcuts: arrow keys navigate cards, Enter opens, quick keys for actions. Real-time: updates sync across users, show other users viewing/editing. Templates: save board as template, create from template.
